name: Summit Recreation Summer Camp
operator_name: City of Summit Department of Community Programs
description_short: Eight week city day camp for Summit residents entering grades 1 to 6, split between the Community Center and the Family Aquatic Center, with crafts, sports, yoga, entertainers and an afternoon swim. Only Summit residents can enroll in the general camp; a 25 spot TryCAN inclusion group takes children from partner towns.
special_needs_notes: TryCAN inclusion camp (25 spots) places children who need accommodations in grade groups at a 1 to 3 ratio; children must be toilet trained, comfortable in an inclusion setting and not need constant one to one support. Families email the child's IEP by December 31, 2026.
swim_waterfront_notes: Daily pool time at the Summit Family Aquatic Center, 100 Ashwood Avenue.
notes: Summit residents only for the general camp. Camp runs Monday to Thursday 8 am to 3:30 pm and Fridays 8 am to 12:30 pm. Lower camp (grades 1 to 3) drops off at the Community Center, 100 Morris Avenue; upper camp (grades 4 to 6) at the Family Aquatic Center, 100 Ashwood Avenue. Wrap around care Monday to Thursday 3:30 to 5:30 pm, $40 a week. Registration January 4 to 6, 2027 by grade. Campers must attend at least half of camp days. Also a counselor in training program and a new travel camp (grades 6 to 9, June 29 to August 6, price to be announced).

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2027 registration information; $975 per camper for the eight weeks; address and phone from the page's Contact Us block. Ages derived from grades 1 to 6
